about: How the first stage fuses the claim rankings (decision 0151): each ranking's reciprocal ranks 1 / (k + rank) are summed times its weight, items each ranking places in its first 30 voting first. The full-text (lexical), vector and named-concept (entity) rankings weigh the same here, as they did before decision 0151. python -m app.scripts.eval_retrieval --fusion measures every weighting of its grid on the hand-written and generated questions in the fused order, read-only, and --out writes the weighting it picks; the lead commits that file with the fused floors it supports.
